claims.text: POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and the driver must carry all four limbs; the rider wins by breaking one. Limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at or before the 'arrived' event, and the derived arrival block computed from the driver's own trace returns qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying in-radius run of 0.0 seconds. No fix in this trace qualifies, so limb (b) fails and the cancellation fee is not chargeable. Disclosure: the trace is IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have arrived only where at least three consecutive fixes each report horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better inside the arrival radius. Not one of the eight driver fixes reports any accuracy figure at all, so every fix counts as evidence of neither presence nor absence and none establishes arrival. The clause then states in terms that where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00901 is IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

Independently of arrival, the minimum in-geofence dwell for a STANDARD pickup is 300 seconds. The driver's own trace returns an accumulated in-geofence dwell of 0.0 seconds and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds, a shortfall of the entire 300 seconds against the trip_record's STANDARD zone class. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable and refundable in full on that shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not anyone answered messages. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00901 is IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

The only route by which the driver could sum separate in-geofence intervals to reach the 300-second minimum is POL-NS-06 limb (i), and that limb requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, covering the pickup road over the waiting window, with type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. The sole advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00901-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no payload, so limb (i) is unavailable, the required minimum is not reduced, and the shortfall stands.

The ledger charges a $5.00 cancellation fee, but under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the chargeable fee is the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee: on a STANDARD pickup the zone fee is $4.00 and in a RYDE_X the tier fee is $4.00, so the chargeable figure is $4.00. POL-NS-08(d) makes a cancellation-fee line that does not reconcile with that figure an integrity defect, so at least the $1.00 excess over $4.00 is not chargeable to the rider. Disclosure: EV-FARE-00901 is IMPAIRED, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD.

The driver's chat messages ('I've arrived at the pickup point, I'm at the lobby area') and the trip_record's auto-confirmed arrival marker are assertions of arrival, not measurements of it. Limb (b) is a GPS test under POL-NS-02, and neither the driver's own messages nor a marker generated from the same GPS measurement supplies the qualifying in-radius fix the clause demands; the marker's 'within 10 m' entry is the platform's own distance claim, not a reported horizontal accuracy on any fix. Disclosure: the GPS artifact relied on is IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

The trace carries no rider track at all. Under POL-NS-04 an absent rider_track leaves the rider-presence limb UNDECIDABLE and neutral - neither satisfied nor failed - and the artifact is impaired rather than adverse, so no inference that the rider was elsewhere may be drawn from its absence against the rider. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00901 is IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

In the alternative, if the Judge holds that the driver's non-arrival and dwell shortfall rest solely on a trace impaired under POL-NS-08(b) - the waiting window holds only four fixes, with gaps of 180 seconds and no rider track - then the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09. Escalation is not a loss for the rider: the disputed $5.00 is placed on hold rather than collected, so the rider does not fund a dispute the automated pipeline cannot resolve.

claims.text: The trip record for this trip contains a driver 'arrived' event at 08:43:00, so POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the source's own record.

The same record shows no boarding event at all - started_at and ended_at are both null - and the trip was terminated by the driver at 08:51:00 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) expressly recognises; 480 seconds separate the arrival marker from the termination, which is past the 300-second STANDARD minimum, so the trip was terminated at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed.

The rider's only exonerating route on these chat facts, POL-NS-04, fails at limb (a): the chat log holds six entries and every one of them is from the driver or the system, so the rider sent no locating or coordinating message at any point in the waiting window. This is not a gap in the evidence - the log is complete, its six entries match trip_record.chat_message_count of six, and no interval between entries exceeds five minutes.

Independently, POL-NS-04 limb (b) is also unavailable to the rider: the driver placed an in-app voice call at 08:47:05, recorded in trip_record.in_app_calls, which rang 22 seconds unanswered and was initiated by the driver, so even if a rider message existed on the chat the driver's call would defeat the limb.

The GPS trace cannot be turned into an affirmative finding that the driver was outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. No fix in the trace carries a reported horizontal accuracy, so no fix is shown to be worse than the 25 m filter and, under POL-NS-02, fixes in that state count as evidence of neither presence nor absence. I disclose that this artifact is impaired - weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD - and the claim survives the discount because what it asserts is the absence of a measurement, which impairment cannot manufacture into proof of absence.

POL-NS-05's false-arrival test is not met on the derived facts. The trace's closest approach to the pickup pin is 0.0 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), so the trace contains at least one fix at the pin itself, and no derived figure matches the arrival marker to a position more than 300 m from the pin or to a speed at or above 15 km/h. I disclose the trace's impairment: weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

The zero-second dwell that a POL-NS-06 shortfall argument needs is an artefact of sampling, not a finding that the driver did not wait. POL-NS-08(b) is engaged on this very trace - sampling gaps of 180 and 240 seconds exceed its 120-second limb, and the waiting window holds only four fixes against the six that limb requires - so the derived longest qualifying run of 0.0 s cannot alone support a ruling against the driver. I disclose the trace's impairment: weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

The driver's account of waiting is corroborated by unimpaired evidence at full weight: the chat log shows the driver announcing his arrival at the lobby at 08:43:00, repeating at 08:45:20 with his vehicle type, colour and plate, and still messaging at 08:50:45 - 465 seconds after the first message and 15 seconds before the 08:51:00 cancellation. That directly contradicts the rider's core assertion that 'the driver never showed up'.

The rider's asserted presence at the pin gains nothing from the GPS record: the source carries no rider track at all, so derived.rider_presence.available is false, and POL-NS-04(c) makes an absent rider track neutral rather than adverse. My point is not an adverse inference but an asymmetry - the driver's account of being at the pickup is corroborated by an unimpaired chat log, while the rider's account of waiting at the lobby is corroborated by no GPS artifact. I disclose the trace's impairment: weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD, the rider_track limb of POL-NS-08(b) being among them.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check cannot be run against this driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is null and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is null, so neither limb of the check - a trailing-30-day count of 4 or more AND a ratio above 0.08 - is established on this record, and the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is not the field the clause reads and may not be substituted for it under POL-GEN-01. Compensation therefore cannot be withheld on this record.

No profile-driven escalation trigger is established. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are all null on the two profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not bite, and with the anti-farming check undecidable in the driver's favour there is no abuse finding against him.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING and carries weight 0.0; its absence is itself citable. I do not assert POL-NS-06(i) against it - the clause provides that asserting a missing advisory triggers POL-NS-09 rather than exonerating anyone - and its absence means no kerb restriction, enforcement operation or closure on this pickup road explains or excuses the driver's position: on his own contemporaneous messages he was simply holding at the lobby, not circling.

The disputed charge currently stands and the rider filed this dispute. The ledger shows payment_status CHARGED, total_charged 5.00 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03 - the filing party's claim not supported and the present state left as it is - leaves the charge in place, which is the driver's outcome. I disclose that this artifact is impaired, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD, and that POL-NS-08(d) is engaged because 5.00 does not reconcile with fee_schedule's greater-of figure of 4.00 for a STANDARD zone and RYDE_X tier; that defect goes to the amount the platform itemised, not to the driver's entitlement to the fee he waited for.

If the Judge finds POL-NS-01 satisfied in full on the arrival marker and the corroborating chat, POL-NS-07 provides the driver 80 percent of the itemised cancellation fee, the residual 20 percent being the platform's service fee, and it is only the anti-farming check that can withhold it - and that check is undecidable here, not tripped. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee: POL-NS-04 fails at limb (a), POL-NS-05's triggers are not met, and POL-NS-06's shortfall rests on the impaired trace. I repeat the disclosure that the fare artifact I rely on for the amount is impaired at weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD.

If the Judge concludes the in-geofence dwell cannot be decided at all, the outcome that does not strip a driver who waited is escalation, not refund. The sole evidence for that deciding fact is the trace impaired under POL-NS-08(b), so POL-NS-08's final sentence caps the outcome and sends the case to a human reviewer under POL-NS-09, and escalation is terminal and replaces the monetary ruling: POL-NS-09 holds the disputed fee rather than collecting or refunding it while review is pending, which preserves the present state against the rider's claim for reversal. I disclose the trace's impairment: weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

ruling.explanation:
This dispute turns on one question — did the driver reach the Tiong Bahru Plaza pickup point and hold position there for the required five minutes? — and the only evidence that can answer it is not reliable enough to decide the case. That is why I am sending it to a human reviewer rather than ruling for either of you, and why the $5.00 stays on hold, neither collected nor refunded, while that review is pending.

To the rider: the GPS trace from the driver's device is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(b). Inside the waiting window it has sampling gaps of 180 and 240 seconds (the limit is 120), it holds only four position fixes (the minimum is six), and it carries no rider track where POL-NS-04 needs rider position. It also puts no accuracy figure on any fix, so under POL-NS-02 no fix can establish arrival — but equally no fix can establish that the driver was elsewhere. That is absence of measurement, not proof of absence. Your argument that 'zero qualifying fixes' proves the driver never came does not succeed: the zero is produced by the trace's defects, so it can neither confirm the fee nor defeat it. Your alternative route, POL-NS-06, rests on the same trace and is undecided for the same reason. Your separate exoneration clause, POL-NS-04, does not apply: the chat log is complete and holds no message from you at all, so limb (a) fails, and in any event the driver placed an in-app call at 08:47:05 that went unanswered (limb (b)). POL-NS-05's false-arrival test is not engaged either — no fix places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or in motion at the marker — and POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not established, because the trace cannot show him stationary outside the radius but within 400 m. What POL-NS-06(i) would need — a present, populated traffic advisory — is absent (EV-ADVIS-00901-01, MISSING, weight 0.0), so no separate in-geofence intervals may be summed.

To the driver: your reliance on your own chat messages ('I've arrived at the pickup point, I'm at the lobby area') does not fill the gap. Those are your own account of arrival, and the arrival marker on the trip record was auto-confirmed from the same GPS measurement, so the marker and the trace are one carrier, not two. Where the GPS test admits no qualifying reading, an account offered in its place stands in for the test: it does not lift the confidence this ruling can carry, and the trace stays the only evidence of the deciding fact. Your entitlement under POL-NS-01 rests on limbs (b) and (c), both of which read that trace, and both are undecided rather than satisfied. The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 cannot be run — no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d are both blank — so no abuse finding is made against you, but neither can compensation be confirmed.

On the money, the fare ledger is also impaired (weight 0.75, PARTIAL_RECORD): the $5.00 charged does not reconcile with the $4.00 greater-of figure for a STANDARD zone and RYDE_X tier, which is a billing-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d). Because the charge itself is undecided, I note that defect for the reviewer rather than converting it into a figure here.

Because the only evidence for the deciding fact is the impaired trace (weight 0.6), POL-NS-08's closing sentence and POL-NS-09(e) apply: the ruling may not exceed a partial refund and the case goes to human review. My confidence is capped at the trace's 0.6, below the 0.70 floor, which is a second, independent ground for escalation under POL-NS-09(a). Escalation is terminal and replaces any money outcome.

Open question for the reviewer: can a validated copy of the driver's trace show he was within the pickup radius and held position for the full 300 seconds? That answer decides whether the fee stands, falls entirely, or is reduced to the $4.00 schedule figure.
